answerable.question: How many products are there?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products

answerable.question: How many categories are there?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories

answerable.question: How many products are in each category?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name

answerable.question: Which category has the most products?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: What is the current price of The Hidden Harbour?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT ph.price FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id WHERE p.title = 'The Hidden Harbour' ORDER BY ph.scraped_at DESC LIMIT 1

answerable.question: What is the lowest price ever recorded for The Crimson Mirror?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(ph.price) FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id WHERE p.title = 'The Crimson Mirror'

answerable.question: What are the five most expensive products right now, with their prices?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT p.title, ph.price FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id WHERE ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id) ORDER BY ph.price DESC, p.title LIMIT 5

answerable.question: How many products are out of stock right now?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id WHERE ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id) AND ph.in_stock = 0

answerable.question: Which products have ever been priced below 10 pounds?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.title FROM products p JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id WHERE ph.price < 10

answerable.question: How many price observations were recorded in September 2026?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_history WHERE scraped_at >= '2026-09-01' AND scraped_at < '2026-10-01'

answerable.question: What was the average price in the Travel category in August 2026?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(ph.price) FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Travel' AND ph.scraped_at >= '2026-08-01' AND ph.scraped_at < '2026-09-01'

answerable.question: How many price alerts have fired?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_alerts WHERE triggered_at IS NOT NULL

answerable.question: Which products have an alert that has not fired yet?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.title FROM price_alerts a JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id WHERE a.triggered_at IS NULL

answerable.question: What is the cheapest product in the Poetry category right now?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT p.title FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id WHERE c.name = 'Poetry' AND ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id) ORDER BY ph.price, p.title LIMIT 1

answerable.question: How many Fiction products currently cost more than 30 pounds?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id WHERE c.name = 'Fiction' AND ph.price > 30 AND ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id)

answerable.question: What is the highest price ever recorded in the Science category?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(ph.price) FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Science'

answerable.question: How many products have never been out of stock?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_history ph WHERE ph.product_id = p.id AND ph.in_stock = 0)

answerable.question: Which categories have an average current price above 30 pounds?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.id WHERE ph.scraped_at = (SELECT MAX(scraped_at) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p.id) GROUP BY c.name HAVING AVG(ph.price) > 30

answerable.question: How many different prices has The Forgotten Mirror had?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ph.price) FROM price_history ph JOIN products p ON p.id = ph.product_id WHERE p.title = 'The Forgotten Mirror'

answerable.question: How many price records are there in total?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_history

answerable.question: How many products were scraped on 30 September 2026?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM price_history WHERE scraped_at >= '2026-09-30' AND scraped_at < '2026-10-01'
